answer: 0001 means **OVERCURRENT**: the output current has exceeded the trip level [4]. The manual lists likely causes as sudden load change or stall, insufficient acceleration time, incorrect motor data, motor/drive sizing issues, damaged cables or wrong motor connection, internal drive fault, or high-frequency noise in the STO lines [4].
